files.original_purpose: Mechanical holdout firewall to prevent access to 2024 market data
files.correctness_concerns: Blocks all timestamps >= 2024-01-01, incorrectly prohibiting future 2025/2026 prospective data
files.security_concerns: Relies entirely on regex path matching ('2024'); renaming a holdout file bypasses firewall completely
files.semantic_concerns: Conflates the specific historical holdout (2024-01-01 to 2024-11-30) with all future time
files.replacement_design: Replaced by ResearchDataAccessGuard with dataset roles, manifests, logical SHAs, and bounded holdout window

files.original_purpose: Execution cost tiers and volatility-scaled slippage evaluation

files.statistical_concerns: Heuristic slippage scaling presented without empirical calibration parameters
files.semantic_concerns: Cost profiles embedded in code rather than versioned policy

files.useful_concepts: Change in portfolio equity / starting equity invariant
